newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse puts Azomures on top tier.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse puts Azomures on top tier.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Friday its most attractive stock, fertiliser maker Azomures SA , would be the first company to move to the top tier since the exchange opened last year.
"Azomures, which proved a quality, highly liquid stock, will trade on the first tier starting January 28," exchange general manager Stere Farmache told Reuters.
The stock exchange, which opened last November as Romania's first bourse in 50 years, now trades another 16 companies, all on the second tier.
Azomures has been the darling the Bucharest bourse since it joined trading one year ago, taking at least half of turnover at almost all sessions so far.
Local investors have perceived it as a true "blue chip" of the fledgling Romanian stock market thanks to its sound financial results and liquidity.
On Thursday it took 80 percent of a total turnover of 261.5 million lei and closed 1,800 lei stronger at 20,700.
To qualify for the first tier listed companies have to meet a set of criteria including net profits for two years in a row and high liquidity.

Data on 1996 net profit at Azomures were not immediately available, but a company report put last year's six-month gross profit at around 81 billion lei. In 1995 Azomures had a net profit of some 14 billion.

Azomures, a state-run company, has a share capital of 172 billion lei, which puts it in the class of big companies, according to Romanian classification. ($=5,612 lei) -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
